title: Personal Portfolio
description: A clean, responsive personal portfolio website built from scratch — featuring smooth scroll animations and a dynamic project loader. Designed to showcase projects and skills with a refined, cybernetic aesthetic.

title: SmartHealth Checker
description: An AI-powered web app that predicts possible diseases based on symptoms entered by the user — combining a machine learning model with a clean, accessible interface for fast and reliable health insights.

title: EatSmart
description: A heart-healthy nutrition guide web app created for the Global Society of Medicine and Health, featuring DASH meals, intermittent fasting, calorie deficit planning, carb cycling, and a built-in BMR/TDEE calculator.

title: Cybernetic Vanguard
description: A futuristic design system and UI framework featuring a modern cybernetic aesthetic with carefully crafted color palettes, typography systems, and Material Design 3 components. Built as a comprehensive design language for high-tech applications.

title: AERO_BOTICS | NEURAL_ARCHITECT
description: An interactive robotic interface featuring dynamic neural architecture visualization and real-time system diagnostics. Built with Tailwind CSS and modern web technologies for smooth animations and responsive interactions.

title: Pipeline Gallery Projects
description: A comprehensive gallery showcasing multi-disciplinary projects within an integrated pipeline architecture. Features responsive grid layouts and dynamic project loading for seamless project exploration.
